reading: Mina stops at a market stall to buy tomatoes for dinner.
After asking the price, she explains that she only needs enough for two people.
The vendor suggests half a kilo, but Mina is unsure how much that is.
Instead of pretending to understand, she asks whether he could show her.
He places a few tomatoes on the scale so that she can see the quantity.
Mina thanks him and realizes that a simple request for clarification made the conversation easier.

vocabulary.definition: a stand or small space where goods are sold
an explanation that makes something easier to understand
